title: More Name Tags
description: this deta pack adds more name tags
body:
# Introducing More Name Tags

a data pack that enhances the look of standard Minecraft name tags with fresh new designs and improved visuals & new recipese. Give your items, mobs, and named entities a more stylish appearance while keeping the classic feel of the game. Currently features 2 custom variants: Copper and Gold, each with its own unique texture and themed design. More variants are planned for future updates to expand customization even further. Includes custom crafting recipes, making the pack survival-friendly and easy to use in normal gameplay. Perfect for players who want small details that make a big difference.
